svg.title: How the project is built
svg.desc: Seven steps. In progress: 1 learn SQL one concept at a time, 2 write queries, each saved with its question, 3 check the data for missing, messy and text-stored values, 4 find patterns using rates, 7 document the case study on GitHub. Planned: 5 recommend only what the data supports, 6 build a dashboard in Power BI or Looker Studio.
